positioning.en: E-2512BL is a dual-layer PET laser-markable label featuring a black surface and white core for high-contrast laser engraving. Compatible with CO₂, fiber, UV, and YAG laser systems, it combines permanent acrylic adhesive with a destructible construction to prevent label transfer or tampering. Designed for automotive VIN plates, engine components, glass labels, warranty plates, and permanent asset identification, it withstands temperatures from -40°C to 180°C, as well as oil, abrasion, and harsh environments. Laser marking and cutting can be completed in a single process, supporting automated production and full-life traceability. RoHS compliant.
positioning.zh: E-2512BL 为双层 PET 激光标签，黑面白底显色，适配全类型激光打标机。采用永久丙烯酸胶与自毁基材，用于汽车 VIN、发动机件、车窗、保修铭牌。耐 −40℃~180℃高温油污，激光打刻裁切一体成型，RoHS 环保，实现零部件全周期溯源。

en: Dual-layer black PET construction delivers sharp, high-contrast white laser engraving.
Destructible label structure prevents removal and transfer.
Withstands temperatures from -40°C to 180°C with excellent resistance to oil, chemicals, and abrasion.
Permanent acrylic adhesive provides strong long-term bonding; heated application further improves adhesion.
Supports simultaneous laser marking and die-cutting for automated production lines.
Suitable for metal, plastic, and glass surfaces, with dedicated laser tapes available for glass applications.
RoHS compliant.

en: Helps prevent counterfeiting, relabeling, and unauthorized part replacement.
Maintains permanent identification throughout the vehicle lifecycle for reliable warranty and traceability.
Simplifies manufacturing by integrating marking and cutting into one automated process.
One label solution for multiple automotive components, reducing purchasing complexity.
Minimizes label failure and rework, lowering total lifecycle costs.
Custom sizes, QR codes, serial numbers, and security graphics are available.
